The Secretariat of the prestigious Ghana Energy Awards (GEA) has officially announced the shortlisted nominees for the 2026 edition of the Awards, marking a significant milestone in the scheme’s 10-year journey of recognising excellence, innovation and outstanding contributions to Ghana’s energy sector.
The 2026 nomination cycle recorded a record-breaking response, attracting more than 600 submissions between 30 th September and 30 th October 2026, representing the highest number of entries received in the history of the Awards. The remarkable response, which included a significant number of first-time entrants, particularly from the private sector, underscores the growing recognition and industry-wide acceptance of the Ghana Energy Awards. Following a rigorous assessment and verification process, the submissions were evaluated across 30 competitive categories, culminating in the announcement of the shortlisted nominees.
The 2026 edition features 30 competitive categories spanning Ghana’s power and petroleum subsectors. The categories include Energy Personality of the Year, CEO of the Year, Energy Icon of the Decade, Visionary Leadership Award, Energy Company of the Year, Upstream Company of the Year, Downstream Company of the Year, Private Sector Impact Leadership Award, Rising Star, and Energy Reporter of the Year, among others. Collectively, the categories provide a platform to recognise the individuals, companies and institutions whose leadership, innovation and commitment continue to shape the country's energy landscape.
Following the announcement of the shortlisted nominees, the next phase of the Awards will involve a rigorous assessment process, including site visits to selected nominees. The Awarding Panel will be supported by a Technical Team of Experts throughout this process to facilitate the assessment and verification of submissions. Upon completion of these activities, the Awarding Panel will undertake its independent scoring to determine the final winners.
The 10 th Anniversary Edition will be celebrated under the theme “Consolidating Ghana’s Energy Sector Gains: A Decade of Excellence, A Future of Sustainable Energy.” The theme reflects on a decade of progress, innovation and institutional development within Ghana’s energy sector, while underscoring the need to consolidate these achievements and accelerate the transition towards a resilient and sustainable energy future.
Anticipation is now building towards the much-awaited Awards Night, scheduled for Friday, 27 th November 2026, at the Labadi Beach Hotel in Accra. The landmark celebration is expected to attract key policymakers, regulators, chief executives, industry leaders, technical experts and innovators for an evening dedicated to recognising outstanding performance, celebrating industry excellence and honouring transformational leadership across Ghana’s energy value chain.
For sponsorship opportunities, event tickets and further enquiries, kindly contact the Awards Secretariat on 055 930 0631 or via email at info@ghanaenergyawards.com.
